items.description: A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments with sku NULL is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the paired branch
A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments with new_quantity below zero is rejected by ck_stock_adjustments_quantities_non_negative on the paired branch
A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments for a (sku, location) pair absent from stock_records is rejected by the composite foreign key on the paired branch

Downgrading to the create_stock_adjustments migration's own down_revision then upgrading head recreates stock_adjustments with its columns, CHECKs, composite FK and immutability trigger (marked @pytest.mark.migration, no relative downgrade)

stock_records rows seeded with per-run-unique keys before upgrading to the create_stock_adjustments revision persist unchanged after the upgrade and after a downgrade to its down_revision (marked @pytest.mark.migration)
A direct UPDATE of a stock_adjustments row is rejected by the immutability trigger and the row keeps its original values on the paired branch
A raw INSERT into stock_adjustments with an empty-string actor is rejected by ck_stock_adjustments_actor_non_blank on the paired branch
The integration test session fixture asserts the engine dialect is postgresql and the URL is the paired branch DATABASE_URL, failing fast on sqlite, in-memory or mocked sessions
POST /api/adjustments for an existing (sku, location) at quantity 7 with quantity 4 and an actor returns 201 naming the sku, location, prior_quantity 7, new_quantity 4 and the entered actor
After one successful adjustment, GET /api/adjustments?sku=&location= returns exactly one audit record for the pair with the prior quantity, new quantity and actor
The audit record's adjusted_at is a server-stamped ISO-8601 UTC time falling between just before and just after the POST
Two successive adjustments of the same pair yield two audit records listed newest first, the second with prior_quantity equal to the first's new_quantity
Adjusting a pair does not return or list audit records belonging to a different (sku, location) pair
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
POST /api/adjustments with a whitespace-only actor returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
POST /api/adjustments with the actor field omitted returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
After a rejected empty-actor POST, GET /api/adjustments for the pair returns [] so no audit record was created
POST /api/adjustments for a (sku, location) with no stock record returns 404 and lists no audit record for that pair

When the audit insert is forced to fail inside AdjustmentService.adjust_to_value (called with its injected session), stock_records.quantity is unchanged and no stock_adjustments row exists on the paired branch
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor returns 422 whose detail names the 'actor' field
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor leaves stock_records.quantity unchanged for the pair
POST /api/adjustments with an empty actor writes no stock_adjustments row for the pair (delta of the test's own rows is zero)
AdjustmentService.adjust_to_value called with its injected session and a blank actor never reaches the repository write (patched repository write is assert-not-called)
After POST /api/adjustments sets a (sku, location) from 7 to 4, exactly one stock_records row exists for that pair carrying quantity 4
PUT on /api/adjustments/{id} for an existing audit record returns 405 and GET still returns the record with its original values
PATCH on /api/adjustments/{id} for an existing audit record returns 405 and GET still returns the record with its original values
DELETE on /api/adjustments/{id} for an existing audit record returns 405 and GET still returns the record with its original values
Every /api/adjustments response (201, 422, 404, 405 and the GET list) has content type application/json and never text/html
AdjustForm rendered for an existing (sku, location) pair shows its current quantity 7 read-only in the adjust-current-qty seam
AdjustForm renders every field (field-sku, field-location, field-quantity, field-actor) with a visible persistent field__label
AdjustForm renders the adjust-success confirmation naming sku, location, prior quantity 7 to new quantity 4 and actor after a real submit
AdjustForm renders field-actor-error naming 'Your name' on a field--error actor field when the actor is left empty
AdjustForm still shows adjust-current-qty as 7 after the empty-actor submit is rejected
AdjustForm renders the adjust-audit-empty state with no audit row after the empty-actor submit is rejected

Playwright e2e on the deployed app at route /adjust?sku=&location= (through the real App, live DB, per-run crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku filed at quantity 7): adjust-current-qty shows 7 and, after entering Corrected quantity 4 and Your name and clicking adjust-submit, adjust-success appears naming the sku, location, prior 7 to new 4 and actor, with toast-success
Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/*.spec.ts, same per-run-unique sku): after the adjustment succeeds, navigating to /sku/:sku shows sku-qty-<loc> with quantity 4 from the live DB

Playwright e2e at route /adjust against the live DB (per-run-unique sku at quantity 7): submitting a corrected quantity with the actor field empty shows an inline field-actor-error next to field-actor naming 'Your name'

Playwright e2e at route /adjust against the live DB (per-run-unique sku at quantity 7): after the empty-actor rejection adjust-current-qty still shows 7 and the adjust-audit list gains no adjust-audit-row

After POST /api/adjustments with delta +5 on a (sku, location) at quantity 7, exactly one stock_records row exists for that pair carrying quantity 12, verified directly against the paired branch database scoped to the test's own per-run-unique pair
POST /api/adjustments with delta +5 on a uniquely-keyed (sku, location) at quantity 7, then GET /api/adjustments for the pair, returns exactly one audit record
The single audit record from a +5 delta on quantity 7 shows prior_quantity 7, new_quantity 12 (the resulting level, not the delta) and derived delta 5
The audit record from a delta adjustment shows the actor the caller entered and a server-stamped ISO-8601 UTC adjusted_at
POST /api/adjustments with delta 0 returns 422 naming the 'delta' field and GET /api/adjustments for the pair stays empty
POST /api/adjustments with a delta and an empty actor returns 422 naming the 'actor' field and writes no audit record
The delta preview component renders current quantity 7 and resulting quantity 12 for a +5 delta on a real stock record, exposed at the adjust-delta-preview seam
The delta preview component renders current quantity 7 and resulting quantity 4 for a -3 delta on a real stock record, exposed at the adjust-delta-preview seam

Playwright e2e at /adjust against the live DB: operator seeds a uniquely-keyed (crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku) record at quantity 7, switches adjust-mode-delta, enters +5 in field-delta and an actor in field-actor, submits via adjust-submit, sees adjust-success, and the SKU detail then shows quantity 12

Playwright e2e at /adjust against the live DB: operator on a uniquely-keyed (crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku) record at quantity 7 selects adjust-mode-delta, enters -3 in field-delta and an actor, submits via adjust-submit, sees adjust-success, and the SKU detail then shows quantity 4
On the paired branch POST /api/adjustments with delta -7 on a per-run-unique (sku, location) at quantity 7 returns 201 and the stock_records quantity read back is 0
On the paired branch the accepted delta -7 POST writes exactly one stock_adjustments row for the test's own (sku, location) with prior_quantity 7 and new_quantity 0
POST /api/adjustments with a delta taking quantity 7 to -3 directly returns 422 whose detail names field 'delta' (message 'quantity would go below zero')
After the rejected below-zero delta POST, GET of the stock record still returns quantity 7
After the rejected below-zero delta POST, GET /api/adjustments for the pair returns an empty list (no audit record)
POST /api/adjustments with a negative corrected quantity of -3 directly returns 422 whose detail names field 'quantity'
After the rejected negative-quantity POST, the stock record still has quantity 7 and GET /api/adjustments for the pair returns an empty list

AdjustmentService called with its required injected session, prior quantity 7 and delta -10, rejects with a validation error naming field 'delta' (message 'quantity would go below zero') and the repository write (quantity update and audit insert) is patched and asserted never called

On the paired branch a direct POST /api/adjustments with delta -10 on a per-run-unique (sku, location) at quantity 7 returns 422 naming field 'delta' and the stock_records quantity read back is still 7
On the paired branch the rejected delta -10 POST writes no stock_adjustments row for the test's own (sku, location) (row-count delta 0)

AdjustmentService called with its required injected session and a set-to-value quantity of -2 rejects with a validation error naming field 'quantity' and the repository write is patched and asserted never called

On the paired branch a direct POST /api/adjustments with quantity -2 on a per-run-unique (sku, location) at quantity 7 returns 422 naming field 'quantity' and the stock_records quantity read back is still 7
On the paired branch the rejected quantity -2 POST writes no stock_adjustments row for the test's own (sku, location) (row-count delta 0)

AdjustPage rendered alone against the real API shows the field-delta-error 'quantity would go below zero' (field--error class) next to the delta field when a delta of -10 on a seeded quantity of 7 is rejected, with adjust-current-qty still 7

AdjustPage rendered alone against the real API shows the field-quantity-error (field--error class) naming the corrected quantity field when a corrected value of -2 on a seeded quantity of 7 is rejected, with adjust-current-qty still 7
AdjustPage rendered alone against the real API renders adjust-success and adjust-current-qty 0 with one adjust-audit row when a delta of -7 on a seeded quantity of 7 is accepted

Playwright e2e navigating /adjust?sku=&location= in the deployed app: seed a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku at qty 7 via /file, choose Adjust by delta, submit -10 with an actor, and see the inline field-delta-error ('quantity would go below zero') with adjust-current-qty still 7, no adjust-audit-row and no adjust-success against the live DB

Playwright e2e navigating /adjust?sku=&location= in the deployed app: seed a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku at qty 7 via /file, choose Set to value, submit corrected quantity -2 with an actor, and see the inline field-quantity-error naming 'Corrected quantity' with adjust-current-qty still 7 and no adjust-audit-row against the live DB

Playwright e2e navigating /adjust?sku=&location= in the deployed app: seed a crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku at qty 7 via /file, choose Adjust by delta, submit -7 with an actor, and see adjust-success, adjust-current-qty 0 and one new adjust-audit-row-<id> (prior 7, new 0) against the live DB
